piko_tools_history_summary: Posts opened and videos watched, including swipes in the video viewer. Stored only on this device.
查看打开过的帖子和观看过的视频，包括在视频页滑动观看的视频。仅存本机。
piko_tools_history_enabled_summary: Off by default. Records opened posts and videos as soon as they become the foreground current page, even when paused; excludes prefetch and DMs. Turning off stops new records, but does not erase existing history.
默认关闭。记录打开的帖子；视频成为前台当前页即记录，暂停也算，不记录预加载和私信。关闭后停止新增，但不删除已有历史。
piko_tools_history_days_summary: Pruned on the next history read or write. Up to 5,000 records.
下次读取或写入历史时清理，最多保留 5,000 条。
piko_tools_history_search: Search post text, author or post ID
搜索帖子文字、作者或帖子 ID
piko_tools_history_empty: No matching history. Recording starts only after you enable it.
没有匹配的历史。开启记录后才开始保存。
piko_tools_history_limit: Showing up to 300 recent matches. Open links use your current X account; an unavailable post cannot be recovered.
最多显示最近 300 条匹配记录。原帖以当前 X 账号打开；无法恢复不可访问的帖子。
piko_tools_history_clear_confirm: Delete all local post and video history? This does not delete bookmarks or downloaded files.
删除本机全部帖子和视频浏览历史？不会删除书签或已下载文件。
piko_tools_downloads_summary: Track Piko downloads, retry failures and open saved files or source posts.
查看 Piko 下载任务、重试失败任务、打开已保存文件或原帖。
piko_tools_video_tools_summary: Playback position, speed and touch lock in the video viewer.
视频页的播放进度、倍速和防误触锁定。
